export_evidence: ImportKey page for COMPRINT TECH-SOLUTIONS (I) PRIVATE LIMITED shows 2867 customs records, but every visible row is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. "2026-02-28 | COMPRINT TECH-SOLUTIONS (I) PRIVATE LIMITED | LA MICRO GROUP UK LTD | MZ7L37T6HBLA-00A07 SSD 7.68 TB SATA | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | LONDON HEATHROW, UNITED KINGDOM | 85235100 | BOL 1107096" — i.e. the company is the Indian importer/consignee, not the exporter. No outbound (India -> foreign destination) bill of lading with date, destination and HS code was found. Source counter: page claims "Total Shipments 2867 Records detected"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 shipment rows (plus 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows, 5 port rows). The ?type=export variant returned the identical import dataset, so no export split is available.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge, and the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Therefore no domestic supply record was seen either way — this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding.
note: Role: trader/importer of computer hardware (SSDs, DDR4 RAM, processors, networking SFP modules) from Hong Kong, UK, Malaysia and USA into Mumbai Sahar Air Cargo (INBOM4). Declared HS 854231 (electronic integrated circuits / processors) is only partially consistent: the observed import lines carry 85235100, 84733030, 84733099, 85176290 and 84733010 — the company is a hardware trader, not an IC manufacturer, so the declared code should be treated as indicative only and corrected to the actual traded lines; per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground. No export shipments found: the customs footprint is import-only, so 'следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено'. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely unknown (all registry/tender sources blocked), not 'declared only' — do not upgrade to confirmed on the basis of the company website or catalogues. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources; not invented). Legal existence not independently verified in this pass (MCA/Zauba blocked); no liquidation or bankruptcy record was seen, so no rejection ground established. Recommended follow-up: MCA master data for CIN/status, GSTIN turnover band, and a paid Volza/Eximpedia export view to confirm the zero-export finding.
